Data Sourcing Steps:

1. SOURCE IDENTIFICATION
   FIX (Financial Information eXchange) is maintained and published by the
   FIX Trading Community (formerly FIX Protocol Ltd.) at fixtrading.org.
   The authoritative, browsable specification is at
   https://fiximate.fixtrading.org/ (the "FIX Repository"); since 2019 the
   protocol is "FIX Latest", upgraded incrementally via extension packs
   rather than numbered releases. The last numbered release before that
   shift was FIX 5.0 Service Pack 2 (SP2); FIX 4.4 remains the most widely
   deployed version historically for market data and order flow.

   The FIX Trading Community's own site does not offer a single
   machine-readable data-dictionary file download in the way mddl.org did
   -- its content is served through the fiximate browsing UI. Instead, the
   XML data dictionaries used here were sourced from the QuickFIX
   open-source FIX engine project (quickfixengine.org /
   github.com/quickfix/quickfix), which redistributes the same field,
   component, and message definitions as machine-readable XML under a
   permissive BSD-style license (see LICENSE). This is a standard,
   widely-used route to a FIX data dictionary -- QuickFIX's spec/ files are
   the de facto reference implementation dictionaries used across the
   industry's open-source FIX tooling.

2. DOWNLOAD
   Files were fetched directly from a pinned commit of the quickfix/quickfix
   GitHub repository (see manifest.json's redistribution_commit) via
   raw.githubusercontent.com, e.g.:

     curl -sL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quickfix/quickfix/<commit>/spec/FIX44.xml" \
       -o FIX44.xml

   Each downloaded file's sha256 and size are recorded in manifest.json for
   data lineage. Pinning to a commit (rather than "master") makes this
   download reproducible even if the upstream repository changes later.

3. SCOPE OF THIS DOWNLOAD
   Only the two data dictionaries needed to document and compare FIX's
   Market Data message family against ORE Studio's own identifier schemes
   were downloaded: FIX 4.4 (historically dominant for market data) and
   FIX 5.0 SP2 (the last numbered release, adding the MarketDataStatistics*
   and MarketDataReport messages). "FIX Latest" (the current, continuously
   updated Orchestra-based specification) was not downloaded, since it is
   not published as a single static XML file the way the numbered releases
   are -- see https://fiximate.fixtrading.org/en/FIX.Latest/ if deeper,
   current-day coverage is ever needed.
